1.1. Approved Workplan achieves 50% completion 1.2. Subnational load shedding schedule (LSS) operational 1.3. Approved national grid stabilization plan (GSP)
2.1. Revision of Electricity Sector Reform roadmap 2.2. Development of Gecol’s operational management plan 2.3. Electricity Sector Reform roadmap’s recommendations and action plan finalized and presented to the Government of Libya
3.1. Feasibility study

1. After the work in 2021, the workplan was 50% achieved. The most important result was the reduction on the grid malfuction in 2021. Thanks to the subnational load shedding schedule that was operational, the blackouts in summer in 2021 in Libya drastically were reduced from 60 to only 1. This was mainly due the critical repairs / load shedding schedule.
2. technical advise has been provided to GECOL, REAOL and NOC. GECOLs operational management plan was developed and implemented. The roadmap is being discussed and it will be presented and agreed upon before the end of the project in June 2022.

1. Formulation the National Sustainable Energy Strategy till 2035, through analysis and evaluation of development approach expected for the energy systems, a part of the overall development process, as per 2030 Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs); particularly, the seventh goal on sustainability of energy systems 2. Development, drafting, submission, consultation, and finalization of the Minimum Energy Performance Standard (MEPs) and Labelling for Split Unit and Window Type Conditioners and LED and other lighting in Libya. 3. Reducing Methane Emissions in the Oil and Gas Sector in Libya

1. Draft strategy is ready to be presented to the GECOL and REAoL prior submission to the Supreme Energy Council and PMO for final endorsement. The National Strategy for Sustainable Energy has been prepared to include the following pillars: Analysis of the energy sector from an economic, social and environmental perspective and the importance of renewable energy and energy efficiency elements in the future energy mix in line with the trend to create a common Arab electricity market. Study options and mechanisms to increase the share of renewable energy in the energy mix. Raising energy efficiency in energy production, transportation, conversion, distribution and consumption systems. Reducing the growth of electricity consumption through energy efficiency measures. The impact of climate change agreements and commitments on the energy sector and the preparation of optimal proposals to make this impact positive in the medium and long term, including a review of international and regional initiatives that are in line with the strategy and which contribute to activating their implementation on the ground and securing the necessary funding. 2. Minimum Energy Performance Standard, Labelling and Testing Requirements for Split Unit and Window Type Conditioners. Minimum Energy Performance Standards and Functional Performance Requirements for Lighting units. 3. A technical workshop was implemented in the field of Reduction of Methane Gas Emissions in the Oil and Gas Industry during the period 17-20 October 2022 in Tunisia. Based on the above a proposal has been developed in line with the main outcomes from the workshop and expressed priorities of the NOC,
